Title: Azure SQL Data Warehouse streaming support in Azure Databricks.

Body.Content:
Azure SQL Data Warehouse connector now offers efficient and scalable structured streaming write support for SQL Data Warehouse.

SQL Data Warehouse is a cloud-based enterprise data warehouse that takes advantage of massively parallel processing to quickly run complex queries across petabytes of data. The data warehouse can act as the single version of truth your business can count on for visualizations and insights. Access SQL Data Warehouse from Azure Databricks using the SQL Data Warehouse connector.

Learn more.
